Since 2008, from solar energy solutions to LED lighting and smart street lighting poles, Muspana’s journey has been about brightening homes, roads, industries, and cities with cleaner and more efficient technologies. Its solar charge controllers, inverters, battery chargers, solar water pumping systems, solar tiles, and energy-efficient lighting products reflect a clear mission: supporting Bangladesh’s transition toward sustainable energy and smarter urban infrastructure.

But this story did not begin with Muspana alone. The journey started in 2008, when a group of BUET graduates founded Filament Engineering with a dream to build advanced engineering products in Bangladesh instead of depending only on imports. After years of engineering work and innovation, Muspana emerged as the prime brand for manufacturing and technology development, while Filament continued as the engineering solution provider.

Over time, the family grew. Filatec focused on light manufacturing, Sense developed galvanized electric poles and smart lighting structures, and FilaVision became the center for research, engineering, and future innovation.

Since the beginning, Muspana has continuously introduced new ideas and technologies. In 2026, that journey reached another milestone with Muspana AgroFly—an advanced agricultural drone designed to protect farmers’ health and reduce environmental impact through controlled and precise spraying.

Through solar energy expansion, Muspana directly contributes to SDG 7: Affordable and Clean Energy. Through smart and energy-efficient city lighting, it also supports SDG 11: Sustainable Cities and Communities.

Today, Muspana continues to move forward as a Bangladeshi engineering and technology brand dedicated to renewable energy, smart infrastructure, sustainable manufacturing, and innovation-driven development—where ideas do not remain only in presentations, but become real hardware.
